coaching_note: This call skipped the entire foundation of the Einstein sale: never asked about the customer's concerns (step 2), never delivered the two promises (step 3), never framed pricing or gave an estimate (step 5), and ended with a soft opt-in instead of a direct ask (step 7). Before the next call, review the first 3 minutes of the card — the two-concerns question and the promises are what separate Einstein from a generic quote line.
